about: Commander precons Wizards has announced that the card source doesn't list yet. Each shows on the Precon timeline as 'Announced' and drops off by itself once precons.json has a deck in the same year with the same name (or that name plus a suffix) or the same commander. Format: { "n": deck name, "d": "YYYY-MM-DD" release date, "s": set code (optional), "sn": set name, "cmd": commander name or [names] (optional), "theme": one line (optional), "sl": true for a Secret Lair deck (optional) }. Add nothing the user hasn't approved.
